verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents auditor-written and auditor-approved policy templates, a policy editor with AI-powered revisions and custom attributes, and personnel reminders for policy acceptance, which implies per-employee acceptance tracking. The evidence never mentions policy version history or a policy approval workflow, and acceptance tracking is only inferred from the reminders feature. missing for 10: policy versioning/version history, policy approval workflow, explicit per-employee acceptance status reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
